rule: Weighted mean of up to 3 sub-scores: V (weight 0.4) = ln(1+n)/ln(1+n_max), where n = the Adey exact-model category LISTING COUNT for the vehicle (Seagull 764, Yuan Up 1362, ID.4 102; a visibility proxy for how many of these cars are in use, not sales or registrations); C (weight 0.4) = part replacement class (routine consumable 1.0: brake pad, wiper, cabin filter; collision-exposed 0.6: bumper, headlight, side mirror, fender, tail light; durable wear 0.4: brake disc, shock absorber; EV regenerative braking lowers disc wear). C is a stated assumption, not collected data; F (weight 0.2) = NHTSA complaints whose text mentions the part / max over ID.4 categories (ID.4 only).
missing_data_rule: F is missing for Seagull and Yuan Up (no NHTSA data: not sold in the US). The mean is taken over the available sub-scores with their weights re-normalised (0.4/0.4 -> 0.5/0.5). F is never set to 0 for BYD. If V were missing, the factor would be left empty.

rule: Local supply-gap evidence from Batch 06 (Jiji + Adey, first results page): exact-model listing for this part observed -> 0.25; only brand-level listings -> 0.375 (midpoint between exact-model and neutral); nothing found on the sources inspected -> 0.50 = NEUTRAL, because 'not found on the first page of 2 platforms' is not evidence of scarcity (Telegram/Facebook sellers and shops were not inspected). Changed in v4 from 0.75 after the sensitivity test showed the top 5 rested on this weakest signal.
missing_data_rule: If the row was not searched (ethiopian_availability = not_established) the factor is left empty and the composite is re-weighted over the remaining factors (flag scarcity_missing). In this build all 30 rows were searched.

rule: From compatibility_confidence: high 1.0, medium 0.7, low 0.35, insufficient 0.0. No level means year/trim/VIN-confirmed fitment.
missing_data_rule: 'insufficient' is an assessed level (no part identified in the sources inspected), so it is an explicit, documented 0, not missing data. The basis column says so.

rule: Can an importer act on the international supplier evidence? Specific part record with a displayed price (row or product_observations) and not marked unavailable -> 1.0; specific record, price on request / request-a-quote -> 0.75; specific record, no price and no status -> 0.6; specific record but supplier shows Unavailable -> 0.3; related part or category context only -> 0.2; no part record -> 0.0.
missing_data_rule: 'No part record' is an observed result of the search (explicit 0, documented in the basis column), not missing data.

rule: How much evidence stands behind the row (points, then divided by the 0.95 maximum): part number identified +0.30; number corroborated by a second catalogue +0.10; supplier price displayed +0.10; fitment confidence high +0.20 / medium +0.10; Ethiopian exact-model listing +0.15; NHTSA failure data available +0.10; price pairing unverified (ID.4 wipers) -0.05; Ethiopian factor rests only on 'not found' -0.05 (v4).
missing_data_rule: Every component is a yes/no observed in the data, so this factor is never missing. Rows with little evidence get a low value; that is the purpose of the factor.
